title: Disc sighting on a Blue Ridge mountain
place_text: Blue Ridge Mountains near Boone, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And um I look up and that same craft, well, it looked the same. I can't say it was the same one uh that I saw on when I was a kid, when I was eight. Now I'm 18. Just turned 18. Appears in the afternoon sky, crystal clear October day.

plain: Steven Greer, who leads a campaign to get UFO secrets made public, says he saw a disc-shaped craft over a Blue Ridge mountain near Boone, North Carolina, in 1973, when he had just turned 18. He tells Michels it showed up in the afternoon on a 'crystal clear October day' and looked like the craft he had seen at eight, though he 'can't say it was the same one.' To him it was a second sighting, ten years after the first.
